tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and preview stage behind the wallpaper. Text on it uses ink or mute.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Control column. Hosts every form section; ink and mute read on it.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input, select, chip and button fill. Also the switch thumb.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel and field.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, panel and field: hints, readouts, section labels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px borders and section dividers; also the off track of a switch. Decoration only, never the only cue for state.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected chip, primary button, on switch, focus ring, slider thumb. Text on it uses accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and thumb marks on accent fills.

tokens.name: mat-green
tokens.usage: Default wallpaper background. Ink on it is white; the pair is 3.9:1, fine for the large type of a wallpaper, not for UI text.

tokens.name: mat-charcoal
tokens.usage: Wallpaper background, charcoal preset. Use with intensity 50.

tokens.name: mat-grey
tokens.usage: Wallpaper background, light grey preset. Ink on it is dark.

tokens.name: mat-plum
tokens.usage: Wallpaper background, deep plum preset. Use with intensity 75.

tokens.name: mat-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Wallpaper background, periwinkle preset. Ink on it is dark; the pair is about 4.4:1, large wallpaper type only.

tokens.name: mat-ink-dark
tokens.usage: Automatic line and text color on wallpaper backgrounds with luminance above 0.5.

tokens.name: mat-ink-light
tokens.usage: Automatic line and text color on wallpaper backgrounds with luminance of 0.5 or less.

families.ui: "IBM Plex Sans Thai", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Site name in the page header and the cover. Also the default wallpaper font for quote, paragraph and label.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Labels and inputs in the control column.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Helper lines under a control, in mute.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section headings in the control column, in mute.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Sizes, hex values and slider outputs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and swatches.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a section.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a control section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Pitch of the plus-mark pattern on the cover.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Color swatch fill inside a preset button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, preset buttons, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch track (34 by 20).

tokens.name: shadow-mat
tokens.usage: Lifts the wallpaper preview off the stage. The only shadow in the interface.

mat.note: Geometry of the generated cutting mat. Numbers are multipliers, not CSS lengths.

tokens.name: mat-cell-ratio
tokens.usage: One major cell as a share of the base dimension, before the cell-size slider (default 95%).

tokens.name: mat-strip
tokens.usage: Width of the ruler strip, in cells, left of and below the lattice origin.

tokens.name: mat-sub
tokens.usage: Minor divisions per cell (10 for millimetre grid without grid).

tokens.name: mat-line-minor
tokens.usage: Minor grid line width in px at 1x, opacity 0.16.

tokens.name: mat-line-major
tokens.usage: Major grid line width in px at 1x, opacity 0.62.

tokens.name: mat-line-frame
tokens.usage: Frame stroke width in px at 1x, opacity 0.8.
